quests.title: Fiesta
quests.summary: Help a balloon pilot at Ashton Court get airborne: an envelope, a burner and a ground crew.

steps.text: Collect Gwen's mended envelope from the Balloon Works in Bristol.
Ask the engineers at Aerospace Bristol for a spare burner valve.
Win over Crew Chief Bex on the Harbourside to get a ground crew.
Go back to Gwen at Ashton Court and launch the balloon.

quests.reward: A Wickerling, Somerset Cider and the thanks of England.

quests.title: Brunel's Notebook
quests.summary: Follow Isambard Kingdom Brunel's trail: the bridge, the ship and the station.

steps.text: Get the first page stamped by the toll keeper at the Clifton Suspension Bridge.
Get the second page stamped aboard the SS Great Britain.
Answer Prudence's question at Temple Meads.

quests.reward: Brunel's Top Hat (an Iron charm) and a Gaugelet.

quests.title: Writing on the Wall
quests.summary: Track down four new pieces of anonymous street art round Stokes Croft, then meet the painter.

steps.text: Find the gull in the flat cap.
Find the falcon in the top hat.
Find the balloon made of apples.
Meet the Night Painter behind Jamaica Street, after dark.

quests.reward: Chocolate, Silver Snares and Saffron's discretion.

quests.title: Peregrine Watch
quests.summary: Help with the peregrine watch over the Avon Gorge, then catch a peregrine to show Hal.

steps.text: Look through the telescope at the falcons' ledge.
Ask the pigeon fancier on the Downs what peregrines eat.
Catch a peregrine and show Hal.

quests.reward: A Peregrine Feather (a speed charm) and two Flasks of Tea.
